personalInfo.name: Sadik Hasnat
personalInfo.shortBio: Mobile and software engineer based in Khulna, Bangladesh. Currently developing robust Android and cross-platform applications at INTELLEEO while completing my BSc in Computer Science & Engineering.
personalInfo.extendedBio: I specialize in architecture-first mobile development with Flutter, Dart, Android (Kotlin/Java), and modern TypeScript web platforms. My focus is on offline resilience, responsive UX, clean state isolation, and production-tested API integrations.

projects.title: FitTracker Health & Wellness Engine
projects.tagline: Local-first activity, nutrition, and biometric metric logging application
projects.summary: A comprehensive cross-platform mobile health application featuring calorie balance tracking, hydration goals, timed workout sessions, and interactive biometric trend analytics.
projects.targetUsers: Fitness enthusiasts and active mobile users requiring reliable, offline-capable tracking of daily nutritional balance, hydration goals, and workout sets.
projects.verifiedProblem: Most commercial fitness apps require persistent cloud connectivity, mandate intrusive account creation before utility, and suffer from sluggish data entry during workouts.
projects.verifiedSolution: Engineered a local-first SQLite and Provider architecture in Flutter. Provides sub-millisecond local reads/writes, interactive data visualizations via fl_chart, and resilient permission-handled biometric health monitoring.
keyFeatures: Local calorie expenditure and intake balance engine with custom food categorization
Interactive data visualizations with fl_chart showing weekly and monthly trendlines
Hydration monitoring with customizable daily goal counters and reminder schedules
Integrated stopwatch and interval workout session logger with historical analytics
Local-first SQLite schema with persistent state isolation via Provider pattern
architecturalDecisions: Selected SQLite (via sqflite/shared_preferences) for offline durability rather than purely remote backend databases.
Used Provider pattern for lightweight reactive state propagation, keeping business logic distinct from Material UI widgets.
Built decoupled repository abstractions to allow seamless future cloud sync integrations without touching widget trees.

challenges.challenge: Real-time chart rendering performance on mid-tier Android devices with high data density.
challenges.solution: Downsampled historical trend data points into weekly aggregate windows before passing coordinates to fl_chart components.

challenges.challenge: Handling intermittent background timer execution across diverse Android battery optimization modes.
challenges.solution: Stored epoch timestamps at session start and calculated deltas on lifecycle resume rather than relying on unthrottled background tick intervals.

knownLimitations: Cloud backup and multi-device synchronization are in active development; all records currently persist locally to the host device.
Camera-based optical pulse detection relies on device hardware sensor availability.
metricsOrHighlights: Zero network latency on metric logging

projects.title: Daily Muslim
projects.tagline: High-performance portfolio analytics and interactive component library
projects.summary: Modern TypeScript web dashboard built with Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion, engineered to deliver accessible dark-mode interactions and responsive layouts.
projects.targetUsers: Engineering managers, technical recruiters, and enterprise clients reviewing technical proficiencies and design system foundations.
projects.verifiedProblem: Typical portfolio starters rely on bloated templates, unoptimized CSS, generic AI aesthetics, and inaccessible markup that fails accessibility audits.
projects.verifiedSolution: Crafted an accessible, dark editorial interface utilizing atomic design tokens, strict TypeScript schemas with Zod, and motion wrappers that respect prefers-reduced-motion standards.
keyFeatures: Type-safe form schema and validation using Zod
Strict dark editorial palette (#090B10, #121720, #C5F467) with WCAG AAA contrast ratios
Zero-dependency micro-animations with automatic reduced-motion accessibility fallbacks
Responsive typography and modular layout primitives built with Tailwind CSS
architecturalDecisions: Implemented central design tokens via CSS variables rather than hardcoded ad-hoc utility classes.
Enforced strict TypeScript configuration without loose `any` types to prevent runtime prop mismatches.
Used semantic HTML5 regions (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <section>, <article>, <footer>) for full screen-reader compliance.

challenges.challenge: Ensuring dark mode contrast compliance across nested card surface levels without washing out text readability.
challenges.solution: Established a three-tier surface token hierarchy (#090B10 Base, #121720 Surface, #161D29 Elevated) paired with high-contrast text (#F5F7FA).

challenges.challenge: Preventing layout shift and animation jank on lower-spec mobile devices.
challenges.solution: Restricted transforms strictly to composite-only CSS properties (`opacity`, `transform`) and throttled resize handlers.

knownLimitations: Dashboard currently displays curated project analytics rather than multi-user OAuth tenant login.
metricsOrHighlights: Full keyboard navigation & visible focus rings

projects.title: MarginX — F-Commerce Profit & Expense Engine
projects.tagline: Profit transparency and unit economics tracker for social commerce merchants
projects.summary: Financial analytics and operational expense calculator designed for Facebook-commerce merchants to track true net profit after factoring in return costs, courier fees, and advertising ad-spend.
projects.targetUsers: F-commerce and boutique online merchants in emerging markets managing high delivery return rates and ad costs.
projects.verifiedProblem: Merchants frequently confuse gross merchandise volume with net profitability, failing to account for courier return delivery penalties (RTO), packaging overhead, and escalating pay-per-click ads.
projects.verifiedSolution: Engineered a dedicated net-profit calculation engine that computes item-level margins, factoring in dynamic return rates, shipping tier costs, and blended customer acquisition costs (CAC).
keyFeatures: True Net Margin calculator accounting for courier return-to-origin (RTO) penalty expenses
Ad-spend Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) break-even threshold analysis
Courier fee tier comparison matrix (e.g. Steadfast, Pathao, RedX integration ready)
Expense dashboard categorizing packaging, product sourcing, and marketing overhead
architecturalDecisions: Architected deterministic financial calculation functions isolated from UI rendering to allow easy unit testing of money math.
Used immutable transaction records to provide audit trails for daily courier delivery status adjustments.

challenges.challenge: Handling complex return-to-origin fee adjustments where merchants still incur two-way courier shipping bills.
challenges.solution: Built a stateful delivery lifecycle state machine tracking Dispatched, Delivered, Returned, and Partially Returned states with automated cost attribution.

knownLimitations: Automated webhook integrations with third-party courier APIs are currently in testing; initial release supports manual tier entry and bulk CSV reconciliation.
metricsOrHighlights: Zero hidden fee leakage in test models

projects.title: RestroFlow — Real-Time Restaurant Operations
projects.tagline: Table ordering, kitchen display, and POS billing orchestration system
projects.summary: Streamlined restaurant workflow platform connecting floor order taking, kitchen display systems (KDS), and cash counter billing with minimal operational friction.
projects.targetUsers: Fast-casual restaurants, cafes, and dining spaces needing instant communication between waitstaff and kitchen stations.
projects.verifiedProblem: Paper tickets and disconnected POS terminals create kitchen bottlenecks, missed dietary modifications, and billing discrepancies during peak rush hours.
projects.verifiedSolution: Building a unified real-time workflow pipeline where waitstaff orders instantly sync to categorized kitchen display stations with status acknowledgments.
keyFeatures: Table grid management with live occupancy and pending order indicators
Kitchen Display System (KDS) with color-coded preparation timers
Split-bill and instant thermal receipt printing pipeline
Offline-resilient order queue for network hiccup protection
architecturalDecisions: Designed event-driven state updates to maintain synchronized order tickets between kitchen and billing terminals.
Structured local caching so pending tickets remain accessible even if local router connectivity fluctuates.

challenges.challenge: Preventing race conditions when multiple waitstaff update table order additions simultaneously.
challenges.solution: Implemented optimistic UI updates paired with server-authoritative incremental item batching.

knownLimitations: Inventory auto-depletion by recipe ingredient is planned for the subsequent release phase.

projects.title: CampusOne — Offline-First Student Academic Portal
projects.tagline: Academic scheduling, attendance tracker, and notices for university students
projects.summary: Mobile academic companion app enabling university students to access class routines, exam schedules, and attendance metrics without relying on erratic campus Wi-Fi.
projects.targetUsers: Undergraduate university students managing dynamic lecture schedules, assignment deadlines, and attendance criteria.
projects.verifiedProblem: University web portals are typically non-responsive on mobile devices, require repeated authentication, and become inaccessible when campus network connectivity drops.
projects.verifiedSolution: Engineered an offline-first mobile client that securely caches semester schedules, calculates threshold attendance percentages, and synchronizes noticeboard updates on network reconnect.
keyFeatures: Offline class routine and examination timetable cache
Course-by-course attendance percentage calculator with warning thresholds
Assignment submission deadline countdown reminders
Local notification triggers for upcoming lectures
architecturalDecisions: Utilized local Hive/SQLite storage on Android to eliminate blank loading screens during network interruptions.
Engineered clean modular domain models separating routine parsing from UI rendering.

challenges.challenge: Handling unexpected routine changes announced outside official portal channels.
challenges.solution: Added manual override capabilities allowing students to adjust individual class times locally.

knownLimitations: Direct automated scraper integration with university portal API requires administrative API credentials currently pending approval.

projects.title: LineUpX
projects.tagline: Structured keyword extraction and formatting audit tool for software engineers
projects.summary: Developer utility that parses resume text, evaluates ATS formatting readability, identifies missing tech stack keywords, and provides actionable engineering resume feedback.
projects.targetUsers: Software developers and junior engineers tailoring resumes for competitive international tech applications and applicant tracking systems.
projects.verifiedProblem: Candidates struggle to understand why resumes fail initial automated ATS screening filters due to parsing incompatibilities, missing role keywords, and vague project descriptions.
projects.verifiedSolution: Building a structured analysis workflow that extracts resume sections, compares competencies against targeted software engineering job descriptions, and highlights specific missing skills.
keyFeatures: Section-by-section structural ATS readability audit
Skill gap detection matching candidate experience against job requirements
Actionable bullet point improvement recommendations
Local history log tracking resume iteration scores
architecturalDecisions: Decoupled document text extraction from LLM prompt orchestration to ensure predictable token usage and cost bounds.
Used Zod schemas to validate AI output payloads, preventing broken or hallucinated JSON structures from reaching the UI.

challenges.challenge: Inconsistent extraction from non-standard multi-column PDF resume layouts.
challenges.solution: Implemented structured text normalization and column hierarchy flattening prior to analysis.

knownLimitations: Complex graphics-heavy resumes require plain text fallback extraction; current release focuses on standard single/double column engineering formats.
